exposure: Stentless LivaNova-Sorin Pericarbon Freedom(tm) (SPF) aortic bioprosthesis
outcome: Major adverse cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events (MACCE)
cohort: The study included 55 patients who received stentless LivaNova-Sorin Pericarbon Freedom(tm) aortic prostheses, matched with 55 patients who received stented Carpentier-Edwards Perimount prostheses, all having undergone aortic valve replacement between 2003 and 2006.
finding: Stentless LivaNova-Sorin Pericarbon Freedom(tm) and stented Carpentier-Edwards Perimount aortic bioprostheses showed comparable long-term outcomes regarding late mortality, structural valve degeneration, reinterventions, and adverse events, but the stentless valve maintained superior hemodynamic performance over time.
followup_time: 10.03 years (mean), with observations up to 13 years
